prompt: I'm building a multi-tenant SaaS with Qdrant. We have about 500 tenants but only ~20 are active at any time. Each tenant has around 100k vectors at 768 dimensions. How do I keep memory costs down?

assertions.text: Uses is_tenant=True in the payload index for tenant_id
Explains that OS page cache keeps active tenants warm automatically
Provides memory estimate based on active vectors (not total)
Provides Python code for both collection creation and tenant index
